Definition: Mitspah, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Mizpah is the watchtower, the place of watching, and its name runs through the whole story of Israel. Jacob and Laban raised a heap there and said, the LORD watch between me and thee; Samuel gathered all Israel to Mizpah to pray and to choose a king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Mizpah is the promise of the heap: when two men part and cannot watch each other, the LORD watches between them, and that is enough.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
